name: Pangolin Newt
description: Pangolin Newt is a fully user-space WireGuard tunnel client and TCP/UDP proxy that connects to a Pangolin controller. It establishes secure, encrypted tunnels without requiring root-level network configuration.

notes.text: A privileged LXC container is required because Newt manages WireGuard tunnel interfaces.
NEWT_ID and NEWT_SECRET are required and obtained from your Pangolin site. Configure them at /etc/newt/newt.env.
